test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 1 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully and decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

a) All SIMs are phones.

b) Some phones are smart.

c) No phone is a keypad.

**Conclusions:**

i. No SIM is a keypad.

ii. Some SIMs are keypads.

iii. Some phones are keypads.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9bf01e9c226a28bc227d23d9ffa5200f367761903e2d2e76c9abeb018cec10b1.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No SIM is a keypads → Follow (As all SIMs are phones and no phone is a keypad. As whole SIMs comes in phones which cannot be keypads, therefore it is true)

II. Some SIMs are keypads → Does not follow (As all SIMs are phones and no phone is a keypad. As whole SIMs comes in phones which cannot be keypads, therefore it is false)

III. Some phones are keypads → Does not follow (As no phone is a keypad. As truth cannot be proved, therefore it is false)

∴ Here, Only conclusion I follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2"
